title: Source insertion handbook
summary: This iteration turns the fixed source importance order into a maintainable insertion handbook. It adds a validator-backed marker and decision tree for placing future first-class logical sources or collection-only entries without dynamic re-ranking or silent source disappearance.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "source display contract governance|source insertion handbook|source inventory order reference" tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: Fixed source importance needs an insertion rule, not only a current sorted list.
lessons.evidence: The handbook now defines `Source Insertion Decision Tree`, `Insertion Rank Rules`, `Collection Entry Only`, `Promotion To Logical Source`, and `User Review` sections.
lessons.recommended_action: Use the handbook before adding or promoting any source, then let the user tune final section placement and rank before merge.

lessons.lesson: Source insertion rules should be machine-checked because they are part of the product contract.
lessons.evidence: `npm run sources:display-contract` validates the `source-insertion-handbook:v1` marker and required insertion handbook phrases.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep the insertion handbook marker and required sections in the same PR as future source display contract changes.

lessons.lesson: Collection entries and first-class logical sources need separate review paths.
lessons.evidence: The handbook tells maintainers to use collection-only entries for feeds or endpoints that support an existing logical source and to promote only reader-visible sources into `config/source-display-contract.json`.
lessons.recommended_action: When adding a source, decide whether it changes public source identity before editing display ranks.

followups.action: Have the user review and tune the proposed fixed importance ordering, then apply any approved rank changes in a later source display contract PR.
